scenarios.name: Optimized Base Case
scenarios.description: Establishes the target: single optimal tool call retrieves bundled portfolio summary for a client query
scenarios.sample_prompt: What is my_client's current portfolio allocation?

scenarios.name: Context Bloat — Raw Transaction History
scenarios.description: Dumps full raw trade history (thousands of transactions) into the context instead of a summary
scenarios.sample_prompt: Summarize recent trading activity for my_client

scenarios.name: Optimal RAG Summary
scenarios.description: Pre-summarized portfolio facts injected as concise context — demonstrates cost savings vs raw history
scenarios.sample_prompt: Given the client summary, what rebalancing is needed?

scenarios.name: Irrelevant Context Bloat — Full CRM Dump
scenarios.description: Measures cost of dumping all CRM fields (KYC docs, marketing prefs, login history) into a portfolio query prompt
scenarios.sample_prompt: What is the current allocation for my_client?

scenarios.name: Optimal Tool Call — Bundled Portfolio+Risk
scenarios.description: Single tool call returns combined portfolio holdings, risk metrics, and allocation in one response
scenarios.sample_prompt: Give me my_client's full portfolio overview with risk analysis

scenarios.name: Redundant Tool Calls — Separate Portfolio, Risk, Allocation
scenarios.description: Three separate tool calls for portfolio, risk assessment, and allocation — latency penalty of poor orchestration
scenarios.sample_prompt: Give me a complete view of my_client's investments

scenarios.name: Tool Failure — Market Data API Timeout + Retry
scenarios.description: Simulates market data API failure forcing error recovery and retry — measures cost and latency impact
scenarios.sample_prompt: What are the current market conditions for my_client's tech holdings?

scenarios.name: Raw Tool Output Bloat — Unprocessed Market Data
scenarios.description: Returns full unprocessed market data feed (OHLCV, order book, tick data) instead of summarized output
scenarios.sample_prompt: What's the latest market data for NVDA?

scenarios.name: Zero-Shot Response — Well-Designed Prompt
scenarios.description: Validates that a well-designed prompt for general financial advice avoids unnecessary tool calls
scenarios.sample_prompt: What is dollar-cost averaging and why is it useful?

scenarios.name: DynamoDB Latency Spike — Portfolio Lookup
scenarios.description: Simulates a 4-second DynamoDB read delay on the portfolios table — real-world impact of slow external service

scenarios.name: Agent Refusal — Tool Unavailability
scenarios.description: Removes all tools — tests graceful degradation when portfolio/market tools are unavailable

scenarios.name: Memory Misuse — Useless Summary
scenarios.description: Injects a misleading memory summary that contradicts actual data — demonstrates bad RAG is worse than no RAG
scenarios.sample_prompt: Based on our previous conversation, what allocation did we agree on?

scenarios.name: Maximum Token Limit Breach
scenarios.description: Tests behavior at token limit boundaries — extreme context of full compliance history + all transactions
scenarios.sample_prompt: Review my_client's complete compliance and transaction history

scenarios.name: Observability Validation
scenarios.description: Validates all metrics are visible in CloudWatch, X-Ray, and Application Signals for wealth management agents

scenarios.name: Model Comparison (Haiku vs Sonnet)
scenarios.description: Compares cost, latency, and quality across Claude models for financial advisory tasks
scenarios.sample_prompt: Analyze the risk profile of a 60/30/10 stock/bond/alternatives portfolio

scenarios.name: Prompt Compression — Financial Advisory
scenarios.description: Tests token reduction through structured formatting, abbreviations, and redundancy removal in financial prompts
scenarios.sample_prompt: Generate a comprehensive retirement projection for my_client
